corinthians2.9.p1.b1.text: Now about the service to the saints, there is no need for me to write to you.

corinthians2.9.p1.b2.text: For I know your eagerness to help, and I have been boasting to the Macedonians that since last year you in Achaia were prepared to give…

corinthians2.9.p1.b3.text: …This way, your gift will be prepared generously and not begrudgingly.

corinthians2.9.p2.b1.text: Remember this: Whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and whoever sows generously will also reap generously.

corinthians2.9.p2.b2.text: Each one should give what he has decided in his heart to give, not out of regret or compulsion.

corinthians2.9.p2.b3.text: For God loves a cheerful giver.

corinthians2.9.p3.b1.text: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, so that in all things, at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.

corinthians2.9.p3.b2.text: Now He who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your store of seed and will increase the harvest of your righteousness.

corinthians2.9.p3.b3.text: You will be enriched in every way to be generous on every occasion, so that through us your giving will produce thanksgiving to God.

corinthians2.9.p4.b1.text: For this ministry of service is not only supplying the needs of the saints, but is also overflowing in many expressions of thanksgiving to God.

corinthians2.9.p4.b2.text: And their prayers for you will express their affection for you, because of the surpassing grace God has given you.

corinthians2.9.p4.b3.text: Thanks be to God for His indescribable gift!
